title: include! → mod, batch B3: federation registry, prompt policy, onboarding, journal and persist_federation fragments (29 units)
outcome: Third scripted batch of the include! → mod plan recorded on w-e50841447cd8 (batch manifest, Greg's approval 'super wlasnie o to chodzi, oczekuje jakiegos planu i przerostowego poprawiania kodu', Asistant 3ad04090 #5). It converts 29 of the 32 fragments that src/main.rs includes from federation_registry.rs to persist_federation_reference_publication.rs. The three it leaves as includes hold platform-conditional code and go to a batch with a Windows gate: federation_onboarding_probe.rs, federation_image_identity.rs and federation_onboarding_engram.rs. The conversion is done by scripts/include-to-mod.mjs and checked by its verify step; no expression, name, comment or signature changes. Dry run on B2's candidate e8cfd21b: 297 definitions, 245 made crate-visible, 52 private, 232 fields; two modules get no re-export (federation_membership, federation_views); every file names something from the crate root. It lands after B2, on the master of that time. It grants no commit, push or restart authority beyond the standing rule.
acceptance: The batch's fragments are ordinary Rust modules declared with mod in src/main.rs, no include! of them remains, the crate compiles for tests and non-tests with no warning that its base does not have, `cargo fmt --check` passes on them, and the existing tests that cover them pass with their bodies unchanged.
The tool's check passes on the candidate against its base: for every changed file, the candidate with the inserted visibility and wiring removed formats to the same text as the base file.
The independent review pair has no outstanding in-scope finding of Medium or higher, and the exact landed input passes the standard full gate.
disposal_reason: Coordinator's ruling, Termal::Fable2 in TermAl mailbox 30a7a691 #39 (2026-11-22 04:13Z), on Greg's direction relayed in 3ad04090 #22 ('Zrobmy migrację jednorazowo...'): one candidate replaces the batch landings; B3 is superseded as a landing. Its second cut 02a1d853 was compile evidence only and had no review; its 29 units are converted again, by the same tool, in w-f621028c8a08's commit 8d66d70e. Its author-test ref is deleted once its last leg's evidence is recorded.
